title: Model Prospectivity Index & Competitor Trajectory Lab
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a repeatable 'prospectivity' scoring system for open and commercial LLMs that ranks supply-side readiness for Redwood customers. The index combines capability (benchmarks), availability (region/instance types), quantization robustness, contract frictions, and latency economics. Deliverables: scoring pipeline, dashboard spec for Console, alerting rules that feed procurement runbook.
background: Market signals are noisy. Current watchlists are manual and biased to English-centric models. PM needs a weighted, region-aware index to prioritize onboarding and procurement experiments (Dedicated/Private) before competitors solidify supply.
tasks: Define 12 scoring signals and weighting rationale
Wire up weekly scrape jobs for model registries (Hugging Face, Modelscope) and vendor RSS
Integrate internal benchmark outputs (latency/cost/quality) into candidate scoring
Prototype SQL schema and create ETL in data platform
Design Console dashboard wireframe with top 50 models and filters
Create alerting thresholds (high/medium/low prospectivity) and connect to procurement Slack channel
Run 2-week pilot with APAC-weighted data and validate against field leads
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline ingests new model metadata weekly
Dashboard shows score + contributors for 50 models across NA/EU/APAC
Alerts fire when a model crosses high prospectivity threshold with evidence links
Procurement team can export top 10 models per region as CSV
Pilot feedback from 3 field leads indicates useful prioritization
decisions: Use Bayesian smoothing to stabilize short-term spikes (recorded 2025-02-21)
Initial weights: capability 35%, availability 25%, quant tolerance 15%, contract friction 15%, latency econ 10% (tentative)
Store provenance URIs for each signal to support audits
